people.name: Dibon
people.line: A city in Judah, inhabited by the tribe of Judah.

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Jekabzeel
people.line: A town in Judah inhabited after the Babylonian exile

translations.web: As for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,
translations.bsb: As for the villages with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba, Dibon, Jekabzeel, and their villages;
translations.kjv: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjatharba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages
